software.name: LibreOffice Language Pack
software.summary: Collection of alternate languages for LibreOffice

packages.name: libreoffice-still-language-pack
packages.title: LibreOffice Language Pack
packages.description: Collection of alternate languages for LibreOffice

generated_script.content:
#!/bin/bash
pathOfApp=$(mdfind "kMDItemContentType == 'com.apple.application-bundle' && kMDItemFSName == 'LibreOffice.app'")
if [[ $(mdls --raw --name kMDItemFSName --name kMDItemVersion "$pathOfApp" | xargs -0) == "LibreOffice.app 26.2.5"* ]]
then
  #Test if the .app have quarantine attribute, or if they are already launched once.
  if [[ $(xattr -l "$pathOfApp") != *'com.apple.quarantine'* || $(xattr -p com.apple.quarantine "$pathOfApp") != '0181;'* ]]
  then
    echo "Silent installation has started, you didn't need to use the .app"
    echo "Add language pack support for $pathOfApp"
    /usr/bin/tar -C "$pathOfApp" -xjf "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/Caskroom/libreoffice-still-language-pack/26.2.5/LibreOffice Language Pack.app/Contents/Resources/tarball.tar.bz2" && touch "$pathOfApp"
  else
    echo "You need to run $pathOfApp once before you can silently install language pack"
  fi
else
  echo 'Silent installation cannot match the prerequisite'
  echo "To complete the installation of Cask libreoffice-still-language-pack, you must also run the installer at:"
  echo "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/Caskroom/libreoffice-still-language-pack/26.2.5/LibreOffice Language Pack.app"
fi

sourceDetails.caveats:
libreoffice-still-language-pack cannot be upgraded, instead use:

  brew reinstall --cask libreoffice-still-language-pack
